messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1: running int4 bring-up for redwood-v2.3-int4 in staging shadow. Short summary: longdoc slice shows a small but consistent rerank degradation. Sharing quick stats and a proposed gated change to the canary.

Jorge: Stats dump below, taken over 24h window at 10% canary vs 90% control.

Jorge: ```
Window: 24h
Traffic split: 10% int4 canary / 90% int8 control
Longdoc slice requests: 18.2k
Longdoc MRR delta (int4 - int8): -0.78% (95% CI [-1.24%, -0.32%], p=0.03)
Short-answer MRR delta: +0.05% (ns)
Top-1 rerank flip rate on longdoc: +1.1% absolute
Latency p95: +12ms for int4
Errors: unchanged at ~0.02%
```

Lin: CI/p=0.03 suggests signal. Suspect quantization causing score shifts for long contexts (maybe KV cache alignment or per-layer scale).

Sam: Proposed canary gating update: start with a "quiet-burn" for high-value slices. Steps: (1) Quiet-burn 2% longdoc-identified traffic to int4 for 4h. (2) If no slice-level regressions, start 5% global canary with checks every 15m and 30m evaluation windows. Auto-fallback if any high-value slice shows >0.5% relative MRR regression with p<0.05 sustained for 1h. Ramp to 25% after 2h, 50% after 6h if safe. Global promotion tolerance 0.25% delta.

Maya: Good. For longdoc, can we also collect dense trace pairs and reranker logits to analyze flips?

Jorge: We should add a rerank-flip detector to the canary health checks: if top-1 changes on the same prompt bucket >0.8% within 1h, flag fidelity drift and count towards fallback.

Lin: Agree. Update rollback circuit to be: (A) longdoc MRR drop >0.5% & p<0.05 OR (B) top-1 rerank flip rate >0.8% for the slice over 1h -> immediate rollback + alert to #eng-ml and oncall.

deploy-bot: Quiet-burn started for redwood-v2.3-int4: 2% longdoc cohort. Canary scheduled to start at 5% if quiet-burn passes. Health checks every 15m.

Maya: I'll run a parity check toggling KV cache behavior and capture reranker logits. Posting back in ~2h with an expanded longdoc sample.

(2h later)

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback executed at 1763222000 UTC. Reason: longdoc MRR delta crossed -0.9% over a 30m window with p=0.02 AND top-1 rerank flip rate hit 1.2% > 0.8% threshold. Canary scaled down and previous version re-promoted.

Jorge: Matches the hypothesis. Please export the reranker logits snapshot and the sample ids for tracing.

Maya: Logs and sample ids stored at s3://redwood-eval/rollouts/1763210099/; attached eval notebook there. Next: run per-layer scale experiments (narrow int8 vs int4) plus KV parity testing, then retry quiet-burn.

Sam: Action items: 1) Jorge to add rerank-flip detector to canary checks (PR queued). 2) Sam to codify quiet-burn in rollout config. 3) Maya to run expanded longdoc re-eval and KV parity tests. 4) deploy-bot will keep auto-fallback rule enabled for next 3 rollouts. Also propose lowering global promotion tolerance from 0.25% -> 0.2% temporarily while we stabilize quantization.

Lin: Fine by me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
